prompt: Perform a final local release-readiness inspection of the supplied Henglish autopilot workspace. Read AGENTS.md, inspect the current branch diff and existing build configuration, and choose exactly one small evidence-backed quality or reliability fix if one exists. Do not invent work. Do not access secrets or environment files, change deployment, Supabase or Vercel settings, create or run migrations, mutate databases, weaken security, add dependencies, deploy, push, open a pull request, commit, or modify files outside the workspace. Run the narrowest relevant checks and pnpm build. If no safe improvement exists, make no changes and explain why. Report evidence, files changed, checks, and residual risks.
